column24: Kudumbashree (1998) — 46 lakh members, Asia's largest women's SHG. Strong menstrual hygiene in schools. Low child marriage (5%).
column25: Highest female literacy (95.2%). Kudumbashree integrated with half of Kerala families for 25 years. Strong reproductive rights legal framework. Lowest child marriage rate in India.

column24: Goa Mahila Aarthik Vikas Mahamandal microfinance. Strong state domestic violence law enforcement.
column25: Highest HDI in India. Strong female literacy and health. Low child marriage (8%). Good internet access.

column24: TN Corporation for Development of Women. Uzhavar Sandhai women vendors. Strong ICDS nutrition program.
column25: Strong panchayat reservation. Above-average female literacy at 73.9%. Good menstrual hygiene policy. Moderate child marriage (18%).

column24: Mizoram Women's Commission. Young Mizo Association women's wing. State menstrual hygiene management policy.
column25: Highest female literacy in Northeast (89.4%). Low child marriage (6%). Strong menstrual hygiene policy. Good safety record.

column24: Meghalaya Livelihoods and Access to Markets (MLAM) women SHGs. Khasi matrilineal land inheritance.
column25: Matrilineal society (Khasi and Jaintia tribes) — women own property and pass family name. One of India's most gender-equal cultures. Low child marriage (8%). Strong widow property rights.

column24: HP State Women's Commission. Women-led MGNREGA groups. Strong ICDS nutrition coverage.
column25: High female literacy (76.6%). Low child marriage (9%). Good menstrual hygiene in schools (hill state initiatives). Strong panchayat women's representation.

column24: Stree Nidhi Credit Cooperative. Mission Bhagiratha women SHGs. KCR Kits maternal health program.
column25: Strong SHG movement. Good maternal health outcomes. Child marriage (24%) declining.

column24: Stree Shakti SHG program. Karnataka Mahila Abhivrudhi Yojana. Beti Bachao strong urban implementation.
column25: Good digital access in Bengaluru. Moderate child marriage (21%). Strong women's enterprise ecosystem.

column24: Ima Keithel (Mothers' Market) — world's largest all-women market. Meira Paibi women's vigilance movement.
column25: Unique matrilineal trading traditions. Ima Keithel in Imphal is extraordinary example of women's economic autonomy. Relatively low child marriage (12%).

column24: SERP / Velugu IKP SHG program — pioneered SHG-bank linkage. YSR Aarogyasri women's health scheme.
column25: Pioneered SHG model scaled nationally as NRLM. Moderate child marriage (26%).

column24: Mahila Mangal Dal forest groups. Van Panchayats women leaders. Uttarakhand Women Welfare Society.
column25: Women lead forest governance. Above-average literacy. Low child marriage (12%). Good mountain-region digital access.

column24: Mann Deshi Bank (100K+ women account holders). MAVIM (Mahila Arthik Vikas Mahamandal). Swayam Siddha women's SHG program.
column25: Strong urban women's enterprise. Mann Deshi pioneered rural women's banking. Mumbai has India's highest women's workforce participation. Moderate child marriage (21%).

column24: Delhi Mahila Kosh microfinance. Mahila Panchayat scheme. One-Stop Crisis Centres for DV survivors.
column25: High urban crime rate significantly pulls score down. High internet access (dgt 78) but high digital harassment. Strong period poverty advocacy in urban slums.

column24: SEWA (Self Employed Women's Association) — 3.78M members, 20 states. SEWA Bank (1974) — pioneered global microfinance.
column25: SEWA founded 1972 — one of world's most influential women's labour organisations. Strong women's cooperative and enterprise sector. Moderate child marriage (22%).

column24: Punjab Women Development Corporation. ATMA women farmer groups. Mata Tri Shakti scheme.
column25: Improving female literacy. Strong women's panchayat representation. Moderate child marriage (16%). Drug crisis has DV spillover effects.

column24: Lakshmi Bhandar (24.1M women, ₹1500-1700/month direct cash transfer). Kanyashree (10M girls, UNESCO prize — reduces child marriage). Rupashree (2.3M women). Swasthya Sathi (2.42M health cards).
column25: Fastest-improving state (+3.4 WEI points). Kanyashree directly reduces child marriage (41% → 34% trend). Lakshmi Bhandar addresses dignity & welfare directly. Period poverty declining in program areas.

column24: Mission Shakti SHG network — 70 lakh women members. Odisha Livelihood Mission women's groups.
column25: Mission Shakti is one of India's largest state SHG programs. Moderate child marriage (28%). Tribal areas have higher period poverty.

column24: Mahila Samridhi Yojana. Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (origin state). Sakhi One-Stop Centres for DV survivors.
column25: Historically lowest sex ratio at birth — improving from 832 to 916/1000. Beti Bachao program originated here. Honour-based violence remains elevated. Child marriage (21%) declining.

column24: CG Women's SHG Mission. Tribal women's forest rights cooperatives. Samagra Shiksha menstrual hygiene program.
column25: Strong tribal women's forest rights movement. Above-average panchayat representation. Child marriage (35%) in tribal areas.

column24: Assam Mahila Samakhya. Tea garden women's cooperatives. SEWA-aligned microfinance in urban areas.
column25: High MMR remains a challenge. Tea garden workers face economic vulnerability. Child marriage (31%) declining. High period poverty in rural areas.

column24: Educate Girls (6.7M beneficiaries, 380K+ girls enrolled). Rajasthan Gramin Aajeevika Vikas Parishad SHGs. Palanhar scheme for orphaned girls.
column25: Educate Girls has transformed female enrollment in rural Rajasthan. Still high child marriage (35%) declining with Educate Girls. High period poverty in rural areas. Educate Girls directly improves Bodily Autonomy pillar.

column24: JSLPS (Jharkhand State Livelihood Promotion Society) SHGs. Tejaswini tribal women's empowerment program.
column25: Large tribal population. Women's forest rights and land ownership challenges. Child marriage (38%) in tribal areas. High period poverty — government pad distribution schemes active.

column24: Educate Girls (operates in MP). Tejaswini Rural Women's Empowerment. MP Rajya Mahila Aayog.
column25: High crime against women rate (NCRB). Child marriage (32%) — Educate Girls active. High period poverty in tribal areas. Honour-based violence reported.

column24: JEEViKA — 1.04M SHGs, 34,000+ villages, ₹11,000+ crore bank credit. Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (girl child incentive). Har Ghar Bijli — electricity access enables digital inclusion.
column25: Lowest female LFPR in India (4-6%) but JEEViKA transforming this. Child marriage (40%+) despite Kanya Utthan scheme. High period poverty — government free pad scheme launched 2022. Widow property stripping common in rural areas. JEEViKA directly improves Economic, Dignity & Welfare pillars.

column24: UP State Rural Livelihoods Mission (UPSRLM) — 9M+ SHG members. Mahila Shakti Kendras (One-Stop Centres). Mission Shakti (UP) — police responsiveness program.
column25: India's most populous state — score has massive index weight. Highest crime against women in absolute numbers (NCRB). Child marriage rate highest among large states. Severe period poverty — government free pad scheme active. Very low female internet access (dgt 22). UPSRLM is transforming economic outcomes at scale.
